panels: upper (no letter drawn): CNOT cost of each of the six pools under the QEB ruler, log y axis, one bar pair per pool. Absolute counts, not ratios

lower (no letter drawn): the percentage of each quantity that the full point group removes relative to the Abelian filter. Its x axis is the two molecules and is NOT shared with the upper panel, whose x axis is the pool

elements.artist: left bar of every pair, both panels
elements.visual: blue #0072B2, 0.4 pt black edge, no hatch

elements.artist: right bar of every pair, upper panel
elements.visual: vermillion #D55E00 with a /// hatch, which separates it from the blue in grayscale

elements.artist: black x marker on a bar top, upper panel
elements.encodes: the value He et al. report in Figure 5 for that same pool, drawn on the bar rather than beside it because it is the same quantity measured twice, not a second quantity
elements.visual: black x, 4.5 pt, drawn above the bars

elements.artist: bars with no x marker, upper panel
elements.encodes: the three pools Figure 5 does not report: the projector-built Abelian pool, the full-group pool, and HiUCCSD in the adapted basis. The full-group bar is the quantity this experiment adds

elements.artist: numeric label above every bar, upper panel
elements.visual: black text, 7 pt, rotated 90 degrees, cleared to 1.6x the bar height so it does not run through the published-value marker

elements.artist: bar group 1 of 3 at each tick, lower panel
bar group 2 of 3 at each tick, lower panel
elements.encodes: percentage of distinct elementary excitation operators removed

elements.artist: bar group 3 of 3 at each tick, lower panel
elements.encodes: percentage of CNOTs removed. Its near-equality with group 2 and its distance from group 1 is the finding of the experiment

elements.artist: numeric label above every bar, lower panel
elements.encodes: the percentage, rounded to the unit
the two molecules and the published-value marker
elements.visual: above the axes, three columns, no frame, 7 pt
upper right inside the axes, three columns, no frame, 7 pt

axes.x: upper: the pool; lower: the molecule and its full point group. The two x axes are different and are deliberately not shared
axes.y: upper: CNOT count under the QEB ruler; lower: percentage removed

params.geometry: He et al.'s, so that their published bars are reproducible; the counts do not depend on the angle
params.ruler: QEB, 2 CNOTs per spin-orbital single and 13 per double
params.currency: distinct elementary spin-orbital excitation operators, which is the currency Figure 5 is written in. The incidence currency is in aggregate.csv and is NOT plotted
params.no_transpilation: no device gate set, no connectivity, no depth: this is circuit SIZE in the QEB scheme only

cnot_cost.normalization: upper panel none, absolute counts; lower panel percentage of the Abelian-subset value
